about_the_game:
A road trip gone horribly wrong. A punctured car. A forgotten haveli. And something waiting inside.

What starts as an ordinary night takes a terrifying turn when your friends vanish in the darkness of an abandoned mansion. Their screams echo through the halls, but when you enter to search for them, the gates slam shut behind you. You are trapped.

Inside the haveli, nothing is as it seems. Lights flicker, doors lock themselves, and ghostly whispers stalk your every move. Somewhere within these cursed walls lies the key to your friends’ freedom—but with each step you take, the evil that haunts this place awakens further.

This is not just a haunted house. This is a prison of despair, fueled by the wrath of a restless spirit. The longer you stay, the stronger she becomes. Will you unravel the secrets hidden in the shadows, or will the haveli consume you forever?

🕹️ Features

  • Survival Horror Experience
    Immerse yourself in an atmospheric horror adventure where every sound, shadow, and flicker of light could be a threat.

  • Puzzle-Driven Progression
    Search for clues, crack codes, collect fragments, and unlock sealed doors as you uncover the path toward your friends’ escape.

  • Relentless Pursuer
    The evil spirit grows stronger with every step you take. At first, she lurks in silence. But soon, she will hunt you.

  • Dynamic Scares
    Expect the unexpected: chilling jumpscares, shifting environments, and haunting events that evolve as the night progresses.

  • Tense Stealth & Chase Sequences
    Hide when you can. Run when you must. Your choices—and your speed—will decide whether you survive.

  • Cultural Horror Rooted in Indian
    Experience a setting rarely explored in horror games, with Indian themed story rich horror game with Hindi dialogues and English Subtitles 

  • Multiple Difficulty Modes
    Whether you’re here for the story or a punishing survival challenge, choose from Easy, Medium, or Hard.

  • Authentic Voice Acting
    Fully voiced in Hindi, with English subtitles for global accessibility and immersion.

🌙 The Haveli Awaits

Every locked drawer hides a secret. Every note tells the story of those who came before you. Every wrong turn brings you closer to the spirit that guards these halls. Midnight approaches, and time is running out.

Will you save your friends—or join the ones who never escaped?
